summary: Evaluate GPU linear solvers by residuals and conditioning as well as speed, including mixed-precision refinement.
outcomes: Distinguish forward error, residual and conditioning.
Choose dense or iterative sparse methods and verify convergence.
sequence: Solve a small system and inspect its residual.
Compare direct decomposition and iterative updates.
Use low-precision factorization with refinement where valid.
Test ill-conditioned and nonconvergent cases against a trusted reference.

visual.question: Can a small residual coexist with a poor solution?
visual.interaction: Change conditioning or tolerance and compare the trajectories.

practice.task: Implement a library-backed solve and an iterative experiment.
practice.success: Results include residual, reference error where available, convergence history and failure handling.
